digest_definitions.full_file_sha256: SHA256 of the complete exact byte stream at the repository path, including any YAML and line endings. This is the digest used by native77 and accepted71+6 baseline pins.
digest_definitions.body_sha256: SHA256 of exact bytes after the closing YAML --- token, retaining its following newline; if no first-byte YAML exists, the entire file byte stream. This matches the original gap inventory definition. No line-ending normalization.
digest_definitions.initial_private_model_sha256: For the 37 reviewed legacy models, SHA256 of the separately retained complete private model file sealed before exact first-response diagnostics. It is a distinct version identity: 34 match the accepted public full-file hash; Vanir, Wiz and Yunyun differ. Within the CI30 subset, 27 match; all seven models in the separate authority-review subset match. The actual owning-seal-listed diagnostic foundation is distinguished from any earlier authored draft.
digest_definitions.diagnostic_foundation_role: Initial private in this audit means the actual owning-seal-listed model before exact firsts. It is not automatically the earliest authored draft. C45 uses DRAFT_02; C46–48 use corrected foundation-frozen copies. Six earlier draft01 versions are separately preserved and differ, while all seven actual diagnostic foundations equal their accepted public versions.

version_exception_decision: Vanir,Wiz,Yunyun accepted public model versions contain historically declared receiving clarifications and differ from their separately preserved initial private model foundations.
